items.title: Snowflake Summit 26 见闻实感：Goodbye Data, Hello AI
items.raw_excerpt: 这次 Snowflake Summit 给我的最大感受，不是“它又发布了一些数据平台的新功能”，而是它正在非常激进地重构自己的产品定位。我认为，它已经不满足于继续被定义为一家 Data Warehouse 公司，也不只是想做一个 AI Data Cloud，而是要把自己变成企业里的 AI + Data 平台，甚至是 Agentic Enterprise 的底座，和 Anthropic 开始竞争。

title_i18n.zh: Snowflake Summit 26 见闻实感：Goodbye Data, Hello AI
title_i18n.en: Snowflake Summit 26 Impressions: Goodbye Data, Hello AI
title_i18n.es: Impresiones reales de Snowflake Summit 26: Adiós a los datos, hola a la IA

excerpt_i18n.zh: 这次 Snowflake Summit 给我的最大感受，不是“它又发布了一些数据平台的新功能”，而是它正在非常激进地重构自己的产品定位。我认为，它已经不满足于继续被定义为一家 Data Warehouse 公司，也不只是想做一个 AI Data Cloud，而是要把自己变成企业里的 AI + Data 平台，甚至是 Agentic Enterprise 的底座，和 Anthropic 开始竞争。
excerpt_i18n.en: The biggest takeaway from this Snowflake Summit for me is not that "it has released some new data platform features," but that it is aggressively redefining its product positioning. I believe it is no longer content with being defined as a data warehouse company, nor does it simply aim to be an AI Data Cloud. Instead, it wants to transform into an AI + Data platform within enterprises, even serving as the foundation for the Agentic Enterprise, and beginning to compete with Anthropic.
excerpt_i18n.es: Lo que más me impactó de esta Snowflake Summit no fue que "haya lanzado nuevas funciones para su plataforma de datos", sino que está redefiniendo agresivamente su posicionamiento de producto. Creo que ya no se conforma con ser definida como una empresa de Data Warehouse, ni solo quiere ser una AI Data Cloud, sino que aspira a convertirse en la plataforma de IA + Datos dentro de las empresas, e incluso en la base de la Agentic Enterprise, comenzando a competir con Anthropic.

items.title: Eatmydata.ai – Local-First Question-to-SQL-to-Dashboard AI
items.raw_excerpt: Yet another "talk to your data and build a dashboard" app, where data does not leave your browser. You ask a question, agents produce multiple SQL queries to in-browser sqlite, never seeing results, and write dashboard configuration code. The data you analyze will be indexed with a local semantic index (embeddings generation + sqlite vector search fully local). Next, sandboxed QuickJS runs this code to produce rich dashboards directly in your browser, no backend attached. This is a fully frontend app (except OpenRouter or other remote LLM). All data sent to LLM's is heavily sanitized and obfuscated at several points. The remote LLM never sees the contents of data it analyzes. excerpt_i18n.en:
"Agentic AI has arrived." NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang declared during his recent GTC 2026 keynote in Taipei. A new consensus is forming: both individuals and enterprises will have their own agents, and societal productivity will be reshaped.  

In the face of this wave, how can agents be deployed securely, run efficiently, and continuously create value? As an NVIDIA partner, Aoni has delivered concrete answers for real-world implementation.  

On June 9, Aoni unveiled a series of major achievements, spanning hardware infrastructure, operating systems, computing networks, and open ecosystems, offering a new practical pathway for large-scale agent deployment.  

**Edge Agent Operating System: Aoni AI Agent OS 1.0 Global Launch**  

In the PC era, Windows defined the gateway to personal computing; in the mobile era, iOS reshaped human-computer interaction. Now, the agent era demands its own dedicated operating system.  

Aoni AI Agent OS 1.0 was born for this purpose. Built on NVIDIA Jetson Thor, it is a localized edge agent operating system designed for government, enterprise, industry-specific private deployments, and offline confidential scenarios. It provides full-stack AI capabilities, including model execution, inference scheduling, agent management, security control, and operational auditing.
excerpt_i18n.es: «La IA de agentes ya ha llegado». Así lo declaró Jensen Huang, fundador y CEO de NVIDIA, durante su reciente discurso en la GTC 2026 en Taipéi. Se está formando un nuevo consenso: tanto individuos como empresas tendrán sus propios agentes, y la productividad social se verá transformada. Ante esta ola, ¿cómo lograr que los agentes se implementen de forma segura, funcionen de manera eficiente y sigan generando valor? Como socio de NVIDIA, Aoni ha ofrecido una respuesta concreta. El 9 de junio, Aoni presentó varios resultados importantes, que abarcan desde la base de hardware, el sistema operativo, la red de cómputo hasta el ecosistema abierto, proporcionando una nueva vía para el despliegue a gran escala de agentes.

items.title: Build an agentic incident triage assistant with Amazon Quick and New Relic
items.raw_excerpt: This post shows engineering teams how to apply that principle to one of the most time-sensitive workflows in engineering: incident triage. You will build a custom incident triage assistant agent using Amazon Quick that orchestrates a response with the New Relic Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server and Asana through native integrations. From a single prompt, the Amazon Quick agent investigates the incident, assembles a root cause analysis (RCA) brief with evidence links, and creates a tracked Asana task ready for handoff.
